notes: Discovery counts are evidence snapshots, not future immutable thresholds; subsequent certified UI milestones may legitimately change them.
No runtime presentation file is modified by M56 merely to normalize the inventory.

classificationRules.authoritative: Current source of truth for a presentation responsibility.
classificationRules.compatibilityAuthority: Current live authority retained because certified consumers still depend on it.
classificationRules.moduleSpecificAuthority: Application-module-owned UI whose workflow differences are intentional.
classificationRules.migrationCandidate: A live authority may be evolved only in its declared successor milestone; inventory presence alone does not authorize replacement or deletion.
